classification.credilana_app_evidence:
WHAT THE CREDILANA APP IS (read-only evidence, 2026-10-07):
(1) It is a separate mobile channel with its own backend. That backend is outside every repo we have (no LAN/DMZ/SS/Magento/PWA code writes origen 'APP CREDILANA' or 'APP PRESTAMOS'). Inside Intelisis it is identified by:
- TipoCredito 20 'Credito App credilana' / 'APP CREDILANA'. 21 'Credito APP Viu' / 'APP VIU PRESTAMOS' is the VIU-brand loan app (vault CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:143-144). 22 'APP MERCANCIA' appears only in the SP code (SP_CREDITO_WEB_VALORES_FORM.sql:1348-1358, header :225-247).
- Firebase push notifications keyed on ServicioAndroid.dbo.CREDICClienteCredilana.Token (SpAAEA00030_ArmadoSMS.sql:138-145,227-252).
(2) The family includes 'App Mercancias' (merchandise on credit inside the app ecosystem):
- LAN commit 5e37ba7 (2026-03-25) 'Servicios de AppCredilana para AppMercancias' created LAN MercanciaController (mercancias/getAbonos, getProximosPagos, getSaldoVencido, getLimiteMercancia, ValidarTelefono). DMZ commit f0c9855 has the same message and adds the DMZ proxy.
- Magento commits bd3cef275..8bf2ecf1c (2026-05-25/06-01) are titled 'Servicios NIP y configurables Credilana para App Mercancias'. They created Mavi_CredilanaConfig (GET /V1/credilana/gestorBoton) and changed the ProductosMX NIP to 6 digits.
- Caveat: the vault (GUIA_MIGRACION_FABLE.md:197-199; PARIDAD:29,244) treats 'APP mercancias' as a separate project. Whether App Mercancias is part of the Credilana app should be confirmed with the user.

WHICH ROUTES THE APP CALLS:
(a) Direct DMZ to LAN, with no Magento or PWA caller:
- DMZ/LAN mercancias/* (LAN Controllers/MercanciaController.cs:17-53; DMZ MercanciaController.cs:16-95).
- DMZ/LAN credit/SolicitudMercancia (LAN CreditController.cs:559, CreditMethods.cs:605-674, origen 'APP MERCANCIAS', IdMagento 'APP MERCANCIA'; commits 1d12e87/36c5030 'Add new service for sql query execution for App Mercancia').
(b) Magento REST used headless:
- /V1/prospecto/rfc and /V1/prospecto/recuperarcuenta. Ticket 10226 is titled 'SERVICIO DE BUSCAR CUENTA EN APP CREDILANA, AGREGAR EN MAGENTO Y APIS (LAN Y DMZ)' (LAN 2efaf85/b6cb672; Magento 4db90a68a/1363953ed). No PWA caller.
- ProductosMX new-client flow: Magento 9310f46d0 'Parametro origen flujo Cliente Nuevo - APP Mercancia' makes setClientData (UpdateFirstData data_c[9]) and saveRequest (CreditoWeb_SaveData_Articulos data[39]) take origen from the caller (CreditMxManagement.php:287,439; the store JS never sends origen).
- Credit checkout for an existing client:
  - 634b0bd3b 'Parametro origen flujo Cliente Casa - APP Mercancia' (Omnipro/PlaceOrder/Model/OrderManagement.php:459-461 registerOrder, :708-710 registerCreditQuote).
  - 289b65597 and 667d5927e add the payment additional_information origen.
  - d5b799464 adds Mavi/CreditoCheckout/Plugin/HeadlessSessionAdapter.php 'soporte Headless a Mi Credito' ('API sin cookies').
  - 51ed6c1e8 adds POST /V1/credit/setWalletBalance ('Servicios flujo de pago con credito sin cookies y sesiones').
  - LAN 00900f0 'Servicios AppMercancia' passes infoCliente.origen into SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS (OrderMethods.cs:434-435,646); 7c6f162 'pedidos repetidos paypal App Mercancias'.
- Openpay card payments ('fix openpay app credilana', 728979acb and others).
- PLAUSIBLE: the Mavi_CreditMigration guest flow.
  - 515ab5ac4 (2026-06-19) adds prueba_de_vida to sendRequest. The PWA never sends it (template Q11). LAN 00900f0 'Servicios AppMercancia' adds CreditRequest.PruebaDeVida.
  - 47d3e6ec0 (2026-04-06) adds /V1/credito/guest/sendRequestNoBiometric 'solicitud credilana sin validacion biometrica'. It has no PWA caller.
(c) No evidence that the app calls the existing-client Credilana web flow:
- /V1/credito/client/*, seguros/* reach SPCREDICredilana / SpCREDICredilanaSeguroDeVida.
- That flow comes from ticket 1333 'MIGRAR LA LANDING DE CREDILANA A MAGENTO' (614ac18..334b5de), and its origin is 'CREDILANA MX'.
- Those objects are labelled STORE ('Credilana web flow inside the store').
(d) SEV (SpVTASMovimientosNIPCteSEV, Origen 'SEV', STDMensajeNip) is a third channel. The only hint is an OutSystems DEV host in the vault Hoppscotch folder 'SEV Connect Sombra'. The App Mercancias catalog is also OutSystems (Magento OutsystemsAttributes, ticket 10073), so SEV could belong to the same app family. That is unproven, so SEV is labelled UNKNOWN.

STILL UNKNOWN:
- the app backend that INSERTs CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP rows with origen 'APP CREDILANA'/'APP PRESTAMOS'
- the writer of push rows (Tipo 1) to TcAAea00030_EnvioMensajes
- the external caller of SP_CREDITO_WEB_VALORES_FORM SaveData/SaveDatosVenta/getClientes/ResultadoBuro
- which origen literal the app sends through ProductosMX/PlaceOrder ('APP MERCANCIA' vs 'APP MERCANCIAS'; the SP tests the singular)
- whether App Mercancias is part of the Credilana app.

analysis.kind: Stored procedure. One @Op dispatcher with 61 operations in 6,126 lines: catalogs and lookups, plus the back-office processing chain that turns a web credit request into a prospect (Cte), then a Venta 'Solicitud Credito', and handles the bureau and SMS steps. Made for the legacy ACW00041 "Solicitud Credito Web" portal (2017). Later extended for Magento (idMagento, OrigenIdMagento, PRODUCTOS MX), the Credilana web, DIMAS, Empresario, and from 2025-2026 the APP CREDILANA, APP PRESTAMOS and APP MERCANCIA apps (header :225-247).
analysis.params: @Op VARCHAR(25), @Val VARCHAR(max), @Uen INT, @File VARBINARY(max), @Search_estado VARCHAR(30), @Search_delegacion VARCHAR(40), @Search_colonia VARCHAR(50) (:251-258). Defaults by @Uen (:281-305): Usuario VENTP04521/VENTP04520, Almacen V00505/V00504, Agente P000505/P000504, Sucursal 505/504, tienda 'VIU'/'Muebles America'. Several ops use @Uen as something else: a flag (getArticulos 1-4), the target estatus (Estatus), the bureau result (ResultadoBuro), the authenticated flag (setMov/updateMov), the file format (SaveImagen), or a Venta.ID (CambioStatusVenta). The ONLY repo caller, LAN CreditMethods.cs:683, always sends @Search_estado/@Search_delegacion/@Search_colonia = '' and a 1-byte @File. So no op that keys on those parameters can work through any repo.

analysis.kind: Stored procedure with 4 independent IF branches on @Op: SeguroDeVida, Solicitud, SetClabe, CallSTP. It has no ELSE and no transaction. The parameters are reused for different meanings in each branch. Created 2020-12-04 for development ACW00041 "Solicitud Credito Web". SetClabe and CallSTP were added 2022-04-25.
analysis.params:
@Op varchar(20), @IdSolicitud int, @Cliente varchar(10), @ApellidoPaterno varchar(300), @ApellidoMaterno varchar(50), @Nombre varchar(50), @NumeroDeTelefono bigint, @Porcentaje int, @IdSolicitudDeMagento int, @Articulo varchar(20), @Condicion varchar(50), @Parentesco varchar(50), @UTMSource varchar(15)='WEBSITE' (lines 38-50).

The meaning of each parameter changes per op:
- SeguroDeVida: names the parameters literally. @IdSolicitud is the CREDIDSolicitudWebDatosPrimerGuardado id. @IdSolicitudDeMagento is the Magento customer id.
- Solicitud:
  - @ApellidoPaterno = delivery method (cobro: referenciado/transf new/transf edit)
  - @ApellidoMaterno = email
  - @Nombre = amount (precio)
  - @Porcentaje = UEN (1 or 2)
  - @IdSolicitudDeMagento = Magento customer id
  - @NumeroDeTelefono is unused
- SetClabe: @ApellidoPaterno = CLABE or card number, which LAN encrypts at CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:253. @ApellidoMaterno = bank.
- CallSTP:
  - @IdSolicitud = Venta.ID
  - @Porcentaje 1 = alta, 2 = actualizacion
  - @ApellidoPaterno = Tipo ('Tarjeta' or anything else, which means CLABE)

LAN binds all of them by name in the EXEC text 'SpCREDICredilanaSeguroDeVida @op,@IdSolicitud,...,@UTMSource' (CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:234). Most are bound as VarChar(-1), including @IdSolicitud and @Telefono, which then convert implicitly to int and bigint. The value array is data[0..11]: data[0]=IdSolicitud, data[1]=Cliente, data[2]=Paterno, data[3]=Materno, data[4]=Nombre, data[5]=Telefono, data[6]=Porcentaje, data[7]=IdMagento, data[8]=Articulo, data[9]=Condicion, data[10]=Parentesco, data[11]=UTMSource (default 'WEBSITE'), at CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:250-263.

ops.what:
Saves one life-insurance beneficiary per call:
- Looks up the insurance header CREDIDSeguroDeVida by (IdSolicitudWebDatosPrimerGuardado=@IdSolicitud, Articulo=@Articulo) (:57-61).
- If the header exists, it only INSERTs a beneficiary row (:63-67).

Creates the formal web credit request for an existing client (cuenta C) taking a Credilana loan:
- INSERTs into ServicioAndroid CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP over the linked server (:88-125). It SELECTs the personal data from IntelisisTmp Cte WHERE Cliente=@Cliente, truncated with LEFT to the column sizes, and writes these values:

  - confirmado=1, estatus=0, utmSource=@UTMSource, origen='CREDILANA MX'
  - ClienteMagento=@IdSolicitudDeMagento (Magento customer id), Sucursal=IIF(@Porcentaje=1,504,505)
  - MetodoEnvio=@ApellidoPaterno, email=@ApellidoMaterno
  - idMagento='PREAUTORIZADO WEB' (positional literal), ValidacionTelefono=0
- Reads the new id back by natural key (cliente, articulo, condicion, ClienteMagento, fecha=@Feha) from the same remote table (:127-134), because SCOPE_IDENTITY does not cross the linked server.
- UPDATEs the pre-request ServicioAndroid CREDIDSolicitudWebDatosPrimerGuardado (Articulo, IdSOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP=@IdRegistro, Importe=@Nombre, Correo=@ApellidoMaterno) WHERE IdSolicitudWebDatosPrimerGuardado=@IdSolicitud (:136-141).
- UPDATEs IntelisisTmp Cte.IDMagento=@IdSolicitudDeMagento (:143-145).
- Returns SELECT @IdRegistro (:146-147).

If the Cte row does not exist, nothing is inserted and it still returns 0, after setting PrimerGuardado.IdSOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP=0.

ops.what:
Registers or updates the STP disbursement account for a sale.
- Sets @Alta=(@Porcentaje=1) and @Actualizacion=(@Porcentaje=2), with @Tipo=@ApellidoPaterno (:160-167).
- Reads TOP 1 Cte.ClabeCuenta, the bank key (ISNULL(CREDICConfiguracionSTP.Clave,1), matched by Participante=Cte.Banco and TipoConfiguracion 'BINESBANCARIOS' for 'Tarjeta', else 'INSTITUCIONESUC') and the event code ('07012' alta / '07013' update) (:169-178).
- If the latest CREDIDCuentaClabeDispersion.CuentaCLABE for the client equals that CLABE, it resets alta and actualizacion to 0 (:180-188). It then calls dbo.FnVTASValidarCuentaCliente(@Cliente) to get @CtaValidada (:190-195).
- Reads Venta.Usuario WHERE ID=@IdSolicitud (:197-200).
- If the CLABE is not null:
  - UPDATE Venta.TransferenciaStp=1 (:204-206)
  - if the account is not validated: EXEC SpVTASAgregarEventoBitacora(@IdSolicitud, @Evento, @Usuario, 'PENDIENTE', 'Actualización TD') (:210-214); INSERT CREDIDCuentaClabeDispersion (Cliente, CuentaClabe, InstitucionBancaria, ValidacionTD=2, RespuestaValidacionTD=2, FechaCapturaModificacion, IdVenta, Tipo 'Tarjeta de debito'/'Cuenta CLABE') (:217-218); UPDATE Cte.IdCuentaCLABEDispersion=SCOPE_IDENTITY() (:220-224)
- Returns no result set.
writes: (via SpVTASAgregarEventoBitacora) sale event log, presumably the Venta bitacora: event 07012/07013 'PENDIENTE' 'Actualización TD'

The INSERT...SELECT inserts 0 rows, @IdRegistro stays 0 and PrimerGuardado.IdSOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP is set to 0. Solicitud reads the new TEMP id back by natural key plus a datetime (:127-134), not by identity. Two identical requests in the same datetime tick, or the Magento retry at :135, can return the wrong id or duplicate rows. Precision also depends on the remote fecha column type (not verified).

SeguroDeVida is not idempotent. Each call INSERTs a beneficiary, and Magento loops once per beneficiary (SegurosDeVidaManagement.php:117-133) with an off-by-one guard ($index > $seguro['beneficiarios'], :118) that lets one extra row through. A PWA retry duplicates every beneficiary. The SP never checks the 100% total or that @IdSolicitud belongs to @Cliente.

CREDIDSeguroDeVida (IntelisisTmp) is keyed on IdSolicitudWebDatosPrimerGuardado, which lives in ServicioAndroid. No FK across servers is possible, and IdSolicitudDeMagento actually stores the Magento customer id, not a request id.
SetClabe always returns 1 even when no Cte row is updated (:151-156). It has no live caller (removed in LAN commit cabd436, 2024-10-02).

CallSTP computes @Evento from @Alta (:173) before the same-CLABE reset (:180-188). A @Porcentaje other than 1 or 2 silently becomes an 'update' (07013). When a bank has no CREDICConfiguracionSTP row, the bank key defaults to 1 (:172).

CallSTP copies Cte.ClabeCuenta into CREDIDCuentaClabeDispersion.CuentaCLABE (PLAUSIBLE). If that value was written by SetClabe, it is the maviCrypto-encrypted string (CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:253), not a clear CLABE.
LAN logs PII in clear text (CreditController.cs:388): CLABE/card number, phone, email and beneficiary data.
The LAN and DMZ route forwards any @Op string unchecked (CreditController.cs:391; DMZ :404-414). The dead or unknown branches SetClabe and CallSTP stay reachable by any holder of the DMZ token.

SpCREDICodigoRecomendador and table CREDIDCodigoRecomendador separate the web from a second app by column Aplicacion: @Aplicacion default 'WEB', or 'CreditoApp' filtered by Nomina. LAN RecommenderMethods.cs:141-146 passes @Aplicacion from the request, and recommender/* has no Magento caller. The recommender routes therefore serve a 'CreditoApp' channel; the UNKNOWN label should name it and ask the user whether 'CreditoApp' is the Credilana app or an employee app. VALORES_FORM 2025/03/07 'Validacion de Codigo Recomendador' belongs to the app-Credilana change set of the same days.

They link an Intelisis or temporary account to the Magento customer for both the web and the app. The backend URLs come from JoinAccount config keys url_join_account, url_validar_cliente and the related SMS/name keys, so the DMZ targets still need mapping.

The Credilana app's own SMS/push row writers: SpAAEA00030_ArmadoSMS also builds 'dispersion de centavo exitosa o erronea' messages (2023) next to the app-credilana push range 30-47/48/74/75.
